refine_summary: Encountered AttributeError: module 'netket' has no attribute 'dynamics' and later 'TDVP' has no attribute 'RK4'. Attempted to fix by changing nk.dynamics.RK4 to nk.TDVP.RK4 and then to TDVP.RK4, but the TDVP class does not have an RK4 attribute. The issue persists after 2 iterations. The correct ODE solver needs to be identified from the netket.experimental.TDVP module.
